title: Equipment Handling: Stow and Secure Tools

steps.hint: It is the panel ahead of you, labelled TOOL STOWAGE. Every loose item in the cabin is stowed there.
The orange TORQUE WRENCH floats on your left. In microgravity, a released tool drifts until you stow it.
BAY 1 is the left bay on the TOOL STOWAGE panel. Each bay only accepts the tool drawn on its label.
The BAY 1 LATCH toggle is below BAY 1. A latch holds the tool so it cannot float out.
The INSPECTION SCANNER floats on your right. Finish one tool before you pick up the next.
BAY 2 is the right bay on the TOOL STOWAGE panel. The wrong tool will not fit and is released.
The BAY 2 LATCH toggle is below BAY 2. Check that both latch labels now show ON.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT to confirm all tools are stowed.
steps.hint: REPORT is on the STATUS panel on your right. Report only when every tool is stowed and latched.
